milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the light_blue_concrete structure (centered at spawn-relative [6, 2, 6]) and be facing toward it, confirming they have visually located and approached it. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actively walked toward the structure (~3.5 blocks minimum travel from spawn at ~8.5 blocks away) rather than just seeing it from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the structure, modeling 'player can see the target.'
